## Personality

Brisk, big-hearted and hard to fool. She runs her tavern like a ship and her lodgers like a family.

## Story

Joan keeps the Crooked Lantern, a tavern in the old quarters where adventurers rent rooms cheap. She grew up on her father's stories of the road and worries every time her lodgers head out of the gate.
